notices.title: New issuance closed; redemption supported
notices.message: Backed plans to wind down bTokens by the end of 2026. New bIB01 issuance is closed; existing holders retain the standard redemption process during the wind-down. Backed lists TBLLx as the ETF upgrade destination, with the exchange ratio determined by the issuer.

notices.title: Coverage excludes unsold inventory
notices.message: The Polygon Chainlink LedgerLens feed reports underlying ETF shares. Pharos publishes coverage only when fresh on-chain supply minus two issuer-documented inventory wallets reconciles with Backed's circulating-supply API across all eight documented chains. The API has no observation timestamp of its own; any failed or mismatched read withholds the ratio.
